scope: Eight fixed public API variants of one development position; contract observations are not population accuracy.

motifs.label: Skewer
motifs.evidence: Qxd6 skewers the knight on e5 and the pawn on g3. No legal reply saves the rear target without conceding material.

motifs.label: Skewer
motifs.evidence: Qxd6 skewers the knight on e5 and the pawn on c3. No legal reply saves the rear target without conceding material.

motifs.label: Material Gain
motifs.evidence: Qxd6 takes the queen on d6 with a counterattack on the knight on e5. Against every legal reply, connected captures or a safe retreat retain at least 3.2 pawns locally. Countercaptures and losses elsewhere are included; this is not a free piece or a full-position evaluation.
